Job Summary

Angelo State University invites applications for a tenured/tenure
track faculty position in Accounting at the
Assistant/Associate/Full Professor level. This position is a
full-time, nine-month position and would start in Fall 2027
although a start date in January 2028 is possible.

About the Norris-Vincent College of Business
The Norris-Vincent College of Business at Angelo State University
is dedicated to providing high-quality education for the citizens
of the State of Texas and beyond. The College’s business programs
are accredited by AACSB . There are four departments in the
College: Accounting, Economics, and Finance; Management and
Marketing; Commercial Aviation; and Aerospace Studies, which houses
an award-winning Air Force ROTC detachment. In addition, the
College is also the home for the ASU Small Business Development
Center and the Center for Student Success, which provides advising
and career services for all business students. The College has
approximately 1,250 undergraduate students and 200 graduate
students, awarding approximately 275 undergraduate and 150 graduate
degrees each year. There are approximately 30 full-time faculty, 15
part-time faculty, and 10 full-time staff in the College.

About the Department of Accounting, Economics, and
Finance
The Department offers a Bachelor of Business Administration degree
with majors in Accounting, Economics, and Finance. In addition, a
Master of Public Accountancy is also offered. The Department has
approximately 250 students, 14 full-time faculty positions and one
full-time staff member.

Essential Duties

Effective teaching, service and publication in refereed journals is
required, consistent with the policies of the Norris-Vincent
College of Business and Angelo State University. An appointment as
an Associate Professor or higher level requires a proven record of
excellence in teaching and peer-reviewed publication. All
candidates are expected to be considered a Scholarly Academic (SA)
and an Effective Teacher at start of employment and to maintain
that status in accordance with Angelo State University’s College of
Business Faculty Qualifications Guidelines.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Excellent written and oral English skills.
Effective teaching record, with the ability to teach in two or more
of the following areas:

Accounting Information Systems
Audit
Data Analytics
Financial Accounting
Managerial/Cost Accounting
Tax

While all areas of accounting will be considered, preference will
be given to applicants with the ability to teach taxation at the
graduate level.

Minimum Qualifications

Doctoral degree in accounting or a closely related field, ABD’s
with a completion date within one year of appointment are
acceptable.
Record of, or potential for, scholarly research and
publications, with Scholarly Academic (SA) status at time of
appointment.

Preferred Qualifications

Professional certification ( CPA, CMA, CIA, etc.)
Doctoral degree from an AACSB accredited institution.
